sections.Profile:
The "Spy Hunter" pinball machine, produced by Bally in 1984, is themed after the popular video game of the same name. Designed by Greg Kmiec with artwork by Tony Ramunni, the game features a distinctive spy and adventure motif.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1984–1985
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Spy, Space, Solid State, Adventure, 1980s
sections.Design Team:
- Software: Rehman Merchant
- Design: Greg Kmiec
- Art: Tony Ramunni
